notes: Documents that are deliberately NOT translated, with the evidence that puts
them outside the project's translation scope. Everything else in
$VIMRUNTIME/doc/*.txt is normal user-facing help and must become complete.
Normal reference or tutorial documents must NOT be listed here just because

exemptions.reason: Attribution and licensing record, not user documentation: it is a list of contributor names plus copyright credits.
exemptions.evidence: runtime/doc/credits.txt:1 '*credits.txt*  Nvim'; :10 'Most of Vim was written by Bram Moolenaar <Bram@vim.org> |Bram-Moolenaar|.'; the body is a column of personal names (':18-:40') that must not be translated, and the license itself is referenced, not restated (|manual-copyright|).

exemptions.reason: Charityware appeal and license text, not Neovim user documentation; translating legal/licence wording would change its meaning.
exemptions.evidence: runtime/doc/uganda.txt:6 '*uganda* *Uganda* *copying* *copyright* *license*'; :12 'Vim is Charityware.'; :30 'The Open Publication License applies to the Vim documentation, see |manual-copyright|.' The page defines the copy/licence terms and a donation appeal, not editor behaviour.
